abstract: Scientists are delving deeply into different types of analysis of which sentiment analysis is the prominent one, which in the current times has emerged as a remarkable field of study. Positive, negative, and neutral sentiment analysis are the three types of emotional analysis. Users may share good and negative evaluations, which can be desirable or undesirable depending on the user experience, on the internet, and on e-websites such as Twitter and Facebook. Our research will look at the most popular points of view to determine the scope and kind of sentiment analysis based on Food Reviews. The study's major goal was to discover food-related sentiments among social media users. We want to show how to gather, pre-process, and categorize data from various social media platforms, and how to analyse attitudes based on Food Reviews. We collected Food Review-related data from Amazon Fine Food Reviews, an information-sharing social media network, to investigate public opinions regarding food review emotions. Various tools are employed in our research work such as matplotlib, pandas, word cloud and NLTK package. After conducting the research, it was found that the majority population had positive sentiments related to the food products and in many cases, they revealed negative sentiments as well.

articleTitle: Internet of Healthcare Things (IoHT) Enabled Incessant Real Time Patient Monitoring System Using Non-Invasive Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In recent years, hospitalization and medical treatment costs have become unbelievably high and costly. Enhancing the effectiveness of the infrastructures supporting healthcare and biological systems with the Internet of Things (IoT) is indispensable in many application areas. Using IoT and non-invasive sensor technologies, it is possible to monitor and deploy patient parameters to the cloud without any delay. The proposed IoHT framework is designed with a Raspberry Pi 4B System-on-chip (SoC) computer. The medical treatment is based on the measured value of body parameters like temperature, heart rate, and SpO2 levels. Patients confined to bed or the intensive care unit are the primary focus of this technique and those remotely located. This study uses the MediaPipe Hands hand and finger tracking system. To determine 3D landmarks of a hand from a single image, it uses machine learning (ML). Our solution delivers real-time performance on a cell phone and is even scalable to many hands. In contrast, the existing state-of-the-art relies mainly on robust desktop systems for inference. This also focuses on gesture-based room automation for the bedridden patients to do their necessities independently. To this end, we want to make these hand perception capabilities available to the broader research and development community to inspire the creation of novel use cases and lead to the discovery of exciting new research areas.

articleTitle: Simulating Optimized Stock Price Prediction Using Deep Learning Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Investors seeking passive income are driving the stock market's rapid expansion. In order to improve stock market predictions, this paper proposes a novel artificial recurrent neural network technique. An increasing number of traders and investors are focusing on the stocks. Investors and investing businesses have long placed a premium on identifying patterns in the stock market's volatility. The study of predicting stock prices is attracting a lot of attention from investors. Many people who desire to invest money in the stock market are interested in predicting its future performance. Livestock market data is collected, analyzed, and visualized, allowing for both online and offline study. The goal of the study is to increase stock price forecast accuracy. The use of optimization techniques like PSO and MVO has been taken into consideration to increase accuracy. There have been multiple studies that looked at using deep learning to forecast stock prices, but those studies came up short in terms of accuracy. Therefore, the suggested study focuses on improving accuracy by combining an optimization mechanism with a deep learning technique. PSO and MVO approaches to optimization were taken into consideration. The accuracy parameters for the optimized dataset and the non-optimized dataset are compared in simulation work.

articleTitle: ML-DP: A Smart Emotion Detection System for Disabled Person to Develop a Smart City
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A disability is one of the main issues that has presented and continues to present difficulties. Disability has been and continues to be a source of frustration since it is viewed as a constraint, a mental, physical, and cognitive handicap that restricts the individual's involvement and growth. As a result, great effort is put into eliminating this kind of restriction. The difficulty that people with disabilities encounter are addressed by this initiative. People with disabilities must rely on others to meet their needs. Machine learning is doing a fantastic job to construct a smart city and offering a secure existence for handicapped people. Because developing a smart city is feasible if we can intelligently treat our handicapped people. To inform the caretaker of the needs, this project develops an emotion recognition system based on landmarks. This study uses a convolutional neural network to recognize facial emotions to comprehend the feelings of impaired people. Only wireless button-based communication, according to the present method, can alert the caregiver that a handicapped person needs anything. This has the drawback that the handicapped person must be cognizant to provide the command. Additionally, as of right now, Assistive Technology has not been incorporated to offer automated assistance to impaired people based on their mood. This research makes use of 468 facial landmark extraction, machine learning, and emotion categorization. Based on the separation of several facial cues, this method can identify seven different types of emotions. The many emotions include anger, fear, sadness, disgust, surprise, joy, and neutrality. The technology will alert the caregiver when the emotion is identified as fear or anger. Additionally, if the emotion is detected as sad, an upbeat song will play until the mood changes. Finally, the caretaker receives emotional value from the system. Thus, our suggested solution takes care of the issue if the caregiver is not close by.

articleTitle: Role of Information Technology in Food Tourism Marketing; A Critical Review of Social Media Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Social media is widely used in the field of tourism. And without the role of technology, it is unimaginable to travel these days, it would be like candy without sugar. Thus, social media plays a vital role in marketing and promotion of food tourism. The focus of the study is to analyze the role of information technology in food tourism marketing and to critically review the various social media channels that are used for food tourism marketing. The study was conducted over 45 tourists who have traveled to Delhi for the purpose of food tourism. The data has been analyzed using SPSS. The study clearly shows that social media platforms and food tourism has a positive relationship. Social media channels highly influence the perception, choices and decision of the food tourist at all the stages of travel. The study also reviews the various social media channels used by the food tourists to view the food related travel content.

articleTitle: A Review of Various Plant Disease Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Many people in India rely on agriculture to support their livelihoods. The volume and quality of agricultural commodities are threatened by diseases. Plant disease identification is one of the big concerns for farmers today. By combining diverse Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Image Processing techniques, numerous researchers have created models for the early identification of disease in plants. An overview of many existing models is provided in this study. Using various keywords, the research papers for this study were chosen from peer-reviewed publications in multiple databases. In order to identify various plant diseases by enhancing system efficiency and precision, researchers will find this work to be a beneficial resource in recognizing the potential of many existing methodologies using data-driven approaches.

articleTitle: Change Identification and Notification Framework for IoT Enabled Smart Security System
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) based smart home appliance control provides better and more comfortable living. The home control system includes temperature control, lighting control, air quality control, security system, water control, etc. A smart system could be used to monitor all the home control systems by maintaining the required parameters in an appropriate range. The extensive utilization of IoT -based smart appliances for controlling the operations of home devices raises an issue of data security. The highly sensitive data are vulnerable to data leakage. A strong authentication mechanism is required for ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of data shared via an open networking system. This paper discusses secure data transmission and identifying the changes occurred during the exchange process for maintaining the confidentiality of data. IoT device has a major constraint of power and small size which leads to restricting the computation to simple. Complex computation and extra overheads could not be deployed on the small processing devices. The widespread popularity of smart IoT -based home automation systems should be strongly secured to prevent any outside interventions and security threats. Thus, the security of IoT device security is of great importance by making use of change identification algorithms. Some Emerging trends and existing security challenges of IoT -based applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Techniques for the Enhancement of Biometric Security: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Conventional techniques to secure the privacy of your personal data included token (for instance ID card) and passwords. And as the use of technology gradually increased, it also became vulnerable in a negative manner. Here's where the role of security comes into picture to provide an extra layer of shield to your personal data. Biometrics or fingerprint scanning ensures security on a much larger scale than that of using passwords or tokens. The biggest advantage of using the biometric security is that it cannot be forgotten or lost and we do not have to remember it. Despite having so many advantages over the traditional techniques, it's also breakable and vulnerable to the spoofing attacks, noisy sensor data and interclass variations etc. There are several methods by which the biometric security can be enhanced or modified and they are mentioned in this research paper.

articleTitle: Addressing Cloud Security Challenges through Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cloud computing is the collection of computing services available through the internet. ICloud virtual services are provided to the user through data centres around the world via the internet. It is currently the base of most Internet applications. Email, web engines, interpersonal organizations, web-based media, and different administrations are currently facilitated in “the cloud”. The accelerated growth in this field by both private and public sectors globally has heightened the cyberattacks on stored user data. While cost and usability are the primary advantages of cloud computing, trust and security are the two top worries of clients of cloud administrations. Blockchain is known as Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT). It is an unalterable and transparent digital ledger that uses decentralization and cryptography for security and authentication. It is the future of security and privacy improvements in the IT industry as it provides integrity, authenticity, and confidentiality to all stored data. This paper attempts to understand the root cause of cloud security attacks along with a proposed solution using blockchain technology and various cryptographic algorithms.

articleTitle: DBNet: Detect Diabetic Retinopathy to Stop Blindness Before it's Too Late
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Diabetes retinopathy is an eye disorder, primarily caused by high blood sugar from diabetes. Due to the complication, the back side of the eye (retina) gets infected, leading to permanent visual impairment if left untreated. Yearly around 5-15% of normal people and 30-50% of people with type-2 diabetes lost their vision due to diabetic retinopathy. Currently, 103.12 million adults are suffering from diabetic retinopathy worldwide. It has been regarded as one of the primary reasons for the vision loss of working-class aged people in many countries. Even after the alarming prevalence, diabetic retinopathy can be fully treated if identified at its early stage. Fundus images of the retina are one of the fundamental mediums for clinically detecting and analyzing diabetic retinopathy through image processing techniques. Neural networks like Convolutional neural network (CNN) and Recurrent neural network (RNN) are two of the most used deep learning models to classify and extract information from fundus images though these models have significant limitations such as overfitting and imbalanced dataset classification for limited training images. The study proposed a hybrid autoencoder model called “DBN et” which combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long- Short Term Memory (LSTM) to enhance the accuracy of adaptive retinopathy prediction from fundus images of the retina. 5590 retinal images are processed using the proposed hybrid model and classified into five distinct categories based on their severity level. The Kaggle Diabetic Retinopathy Dataset is used to perform the experiments and accuracy is calculated using the Kappa method. The results yielded 93% accuracy in terms of the proposed DBNet where the conventional CNN and LSTM model achieved an accuracy of 69% and 78% respectively. Such promising results demonstrate the viability of the proposed model in identifying diabetic retinopathy at its early stage and reducing the number of blind cases because of it.

articleTitle: Big Data, a Big Thing for Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research paper exhibits the architecture of Big Data implementation in higher education sector with several components that are responsible for providing various features and services to the stakeholders of higher education. Big Data implementation can yield enormous benefits to students, teachers and at the same time can also significantly help higher education management to plan, preempt and predict several aspects that can result in a timely availability of resources and infrastructure. This research study exhibits an architecture with appropriate components that would yield several benefits to higher education institutions if implemented in appropriate manner. The research study proposes and explains different components of the architecture and provides details about how this implementation would yield benefits for different stakeholders. The components of the architecture are thoughtfully placed and designed considering variety of requirements of different stakeholders in a higher education establishment. The architecture proposes a separate component for enhancing teaching and learning, a separate component that would be responsible for assisting and supporting academic faculty and an entirely different component providing critical inputs to administration and management of higher education establishments. This research study is a mere effort to enhance the higher education in variety of aspects and provide advanced features to different stakeholders of higher education.

Author Keywords: Big Data architecture for higher education

articleTitle: DT-DL Based Hybrid Approach for Early Detection of Diabetes Using PIMA Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: According to the International Diabetes Foundation (IDF) 2019 report, 463 million people are living with diabetes, which is likely to increase to 700 million by 2045. Diabetes Mellitus is a metabolic disease with a persistent increase in pervasiveness. Therefore, it is one of the most severe challenges in developed and developing countries. Detection of diabetes is critical in the early phase so that the progression of the disease can be stopped at a definite complication. Therefore, it is mandatory to build an automatic tool that can predict diabetes at an early stage. The machine learning approach has been proven promising for detecting diabetes accurately and is hence used in many diabetes detection processes. This study presents the practical hybrid approach by combining two machine learning algorithms (Decision tree, Deep learning) that may provide prediction and early detection of diabetes securely and effectively. This study's result confirms that the proposed framework can be applied for early diabetes detection with ID3 and J48 algorithms to analyze the performance. The accuracy achieved by these algorithms was recorded as 94.6% and 88.2%, respectively. Additionally, results are compared with the proposed DT-DL hybrid classification approach, which shows that our proposed approach outperforms other traditional approaches with an accuracy of 96.62%. The outcome of this study shows that the hybrid approach of DT-DL provides the most promising results with the best-extracted features.

articleTitle: A Study of Role and Importance of Academic Collaborations/Memorandum of Understanding in Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In an educational institution, collaboration plays an important role in the growth of students, faculties, staff as well as the institute. Collaboration is a way where two different bodies join hands with each other to strengthen the capabilities of their students and faculties through research, technology transfer and development of management competencies. Effective university-industry-research organization requires technology and knowledge transfer to sustain and strengthen the knowledge, research and technology on the one hand, while on the other hand, to develop and learn about new technologies, expertise in management than it requires to build and manage the relationship with external partners. The purpose of this paper is to provide knowledge regarding collaboration in Higher Education institutions. This paper discussed the concepts of collaboration, their components, types, benefits for students, teachers, and collaborative partners, and the influence of collaboration in Higher Education Institutions. The review discerned three forms of collaboration: (1) research collaboration, (2) academic collaboration and (3) industry collaboration. Therefore, these collaborations make the add-value to the performance of every institution and provide opportunities to explore, learn and perform the job in an efficient manner. It also promotes the goals and principles of collaboration for students, alumni, faculty, and staff through knowledge sharing, resource sharing, and exchange programs [23]. The approach presented in this study attempts to provide information and understanding regarding the benefits, work, and outcomes that HEIs can achieve through collaboration.

articleTitle: Soft Robotics in Education
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Soft robotics is one of the fastest growing fields in the robotics community and its promise to revolutionize robotics in society and industry is becoming clear. Despite critical applications and use, this research field is quite young. In addition, the fabrication and operation of soft robots are fundamentally different. Soft robots are fabricated using material synthesis, while traditional robots are constructed of prefabricated, rigid materials, and they operate with mechanical assemblies. Several different technological components and disciplines are involved in soft robotics education, which presents a significant challenge. There are no existing teaching methods that cover the entire range of related knowledge because most existing approaches focus on robots with fixed morphologies and rigid structures. This paper discusses how to apply soft robotics research to robotics education and presents related challenges and perspectives.

articleTitle: GUI Testing Android Application
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: With the turn of events and promotion of versatile Internet, cell phones are turning out to be increasingly well known. Android is perhaps the most well known groundwork of mobile phones. Realistic UI testing is one significant piece of its quality affirmation. Android telephones use contact screen as the significant I/O technique. GUI testing on android stage will be different to regular programming applications that are intended to run on work area climate. The point of this examination is to evaluate the presentation of two GUI testing draws near (second versus third era) of mechanized UI testing regarding testing Android applications. We have picked UI Automator and Appium to address second period GUI testing approach, Eye Automate and SikuliX to address third time GUI testing approach. Apparatuses utilizing third era GUI testing approach invest in some opportunity to execute experiments than instruments utilizing second era GUI testing approach. It is different between various experiments. Other than bogus positive cautions show up at a lot higher recurrence in apparatuses utilizing third era GUI testing approach than instruments utilizing second era GUI testing approach. Third era GUI testing approach is more effective as far as executing experiments than the second-era GUI testing approach. However, third era GUI testing approach observes significantly more misleading up-sides than second era approach. Accordingly, to keep up with experiments, third era approach consumes loads of human endeavors.

articleTitle: Role of Technology in Employment Generation in India
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The aim of this research paper is to analyse the role and measure the impact of technology in Employment generation. Innovation is one of the fundamental elements impacting the drawn-out financial development of any country. The promising development of efficiency and resulting financial development in the years to come is presented by the improvements in the Information Communication and Technology-advanced mechanics, and other IT developments are arising. More than 658 million Indians use the internet, and it is anticipated to grow only. Workplace practices have been significantly altered by technologies like social networking, mobile apps, cloud computing and storage, and tablet and smartphone use. These technologies have a beneficial effect on productivity by increasing collaborative work, which results in a 131 percent boost in operational efficiency and a 22 percent increase in project delivery on time. Information and communication technology aimed to improve productivity, has an impact on employment in any industry. Initially the outcome of implementation of ICT introduction is a decline workers employed. But after a certain level the outcome reaches to a plateau. If the firm‘s or industry’s business requirements grow, it may be obligatory to begin hiring new employees to meet the augmented industry demands. Several Indian industries are represented by data in this paper. To examine how technology affects employment, secondary data has been used.

articleTitle: Generation of Quality Web Services: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Business is expanding through the internet these days and web services are becoming the main components of the internet for business. Thus, web services should be faster and secure enough to facilitate business. Still, the area of quality web service generation is very new and there are lots of scopes to pursue research in it. The generation of quality web services is a requisite to get a better response from business users. There are three main attributes of quality web services, web service selection and composition, security of web services and performance of web services. The expected quality of web services can be achieved by providing these three attributes. Hence In this paper, we have reviewed the literature available for these three quality domains of web services and acknowledged the issues that can upset the quality of web services.

articleTitle: Automated Pipeline Preprocessing Techniques for Alzhiemer Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is the most prevalent diseases that should be treated within the shortest amount of time possible. A delay in diagnosing AD can adversely affect the treatment of AD patients in the most effective manner. Many tools are available for the purpose of observing the reasons behind AD detection. In order to detect AD, the most common tool is the free surfer. Free surfer contains a pipeline that consists of all the preprocessing steps necessary to take out the most prominent features for detection. In this article, we have also used free surfer methods for preprocessing and feature extraction. Furthermore, we discussed the various tools available for preprocessing and feature extraction for AD detection.

articleTitle: A Modified Approach to Decrease Packet Loss Ratio and PDR in AODV Using Fuzzy Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Black hole attack on an AODV-based network has been modeled in many studies. A Fuzzy Logic Approach to AODV Routing Protocol is the Focus of This Research. Black hole attacks on AODV routing may be mitigated by employing fuzzy logic. Fuzzy-based and traditional models have been used to quantify the effect of black hole attacks on network performance in simulations of these assaults. To improve the performance of AODV-based networks over more traditional models, fuzzy logic uses random node selection to choose nodes at random. A simulation has shown the impact rogue nodes have on packet delivery, packet loss, end-to-end delivery, & routing overhead. As a comparison between the standard model and the recommended one, the Ratio of packet delivery has been taken into consideration as well. Data that may be used to identify the optimum path between two places in a computer network is sent using the routing protocol. Routing algorithms are used while deciding on a certain route. Pre-existing knowledge about the networks that would be directly linked to the router was already in existence. In cryptography, a method is used to encrypt a message, and the message is decrypted using the same technique. When a third party is present and two parties must communicate confidentially, this approach is used. A novel routing protocol method is analyzed and compared to a unique encryption approach as part of this research, which aims to improve the performance of routing protocols. Working toward a high-speed, secure protocol is the primary goal. The result shows that the proposed work shows promising results in terms of packet loss and packet delivery ratio when compared with the existing result.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in Childhood Asthma Prediction: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Asthma is a prevalent chronic lung conditions in childhood that is responsible due to airways inflammation. As early as possible an extensive global effort should be made to create a tools for recognizing asthma risk with the purpose of offering medical treatment and prevention measures to children. In the current state prediction of childhood asthma, researchers provided a conventional statistical model that have sensitivity, low accuracy and positive predictive value and employ a limited sample size. By examining trends and discovering patterns from huge and complicated datasets, machine learning is a method that is used to construct predictive models for above conventional models. Few research have looked at a huge data set utilizing certain criteria to build an algorithm by applying machine learning technique to anticipate asthma in childhood. This study intends to objectively evaluate the most recent research, identify its limits, and explore its use in clinical application by health care providers to anticipate the asthma emergence in the future and provide timely medical attention to the greatest extent.

articleTitle: Detection of Breast Cancer Through the Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The loss of life through cancer is one of humanity's serious issues in the growing world. India alone has witnessed 30% of the instances of these diseases at some stage in the previous few years and its miles possibly to increase. Breast cancer in India debts that one girl is identified each minute and every nine minutes, one girl dies. Early recognition and prognosis can save the existence of infected patients. By considering this reason we have tried to create a machine learning model which will help to predict breast cancer in a woman. We have taken 3 machine learning algorithms, instance, logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. The reason behind taking 3 machine learning algorithms is to find the best suitable algorithm with maximum precision. Also, used a dataset containing the cells report of women around the world. The dataset contains 30 highlights like mean range, mean surface, add up perimeter, add up the region, add up minimization, add up concavity, etc., and this dataset is utilized to prepare and test our model. All examinations are executed inside a recreation environment and led in the Anaconda platform. We have carried out this research to anticipate, identify and examine the precision for detection of breast malignant growth. Future studies may be performed to anticipate different factors, and breast malignant growth examination can be sorted in light of these variables.

articleTitle: Simulation tools analysis in Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Underwater wireless sensor networks have developed very conservative for monitoring a large area of oceans. The environment under the water is very challenging and unpredictable. Sensor nodes are positioned at the surface of the water whose task is to monitor the environment under the water. Under water wireless sensor networks provide continuous observation for various applications like sampling oceans networks, pollution monitoring, sub marine detection, disaster detection, etc. In underwater environment it is extremely costly to organize a complete test bed and data links to check the validity of network protocols or techniques. The challenge of testing a network protocol or technique leads to a need of simulation environment which can replicate the real under-water environment. Various simulators are designed for simulation of underwater sensor networks protocols, selection of suitable simulation tool is very challenging task. Various features like software platform, underwater environmental support, simulation language measure the effectiveness of simulator. So, it becomes essential to study various modelling methods and to distinguish various features of existing underwater simulators. This paper presents a simple analysis of various simulators used for simulating underwater environment. Main features of different network simulators, their advantages and disadvantages are also discussed.

articleTitle: A Security and Privacy of Cloud-Assisted Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Healthcare System is an essential asset in the lives of people worldwide. The advances in digital communication technology have significantly impacted the healthcare business during the past several years. Digital communication technology enables integrated healthcare systems, allowing healthcare participants to efficiently arrange their operations, tailored and preventative healthcare to people, and increase design and operational efficiency. Cloud computing is a rapidly developing new technology incorporated into the healthcare system. According to the results of a recent study of all healthcare companies, cloud computing is necessary to store patient protected health information (PHI) and aid in emergencies utilizing a cloud-based virtual server. This technology not only helps to minimize the expenses connected with healthcare, but it also helps to save lives by providing a quick diagnosis. When exchanging sensitive information, various privacy problems occur, which must be addressed. This study aims to discover multiple schemes and taxonomies related to the current ways of cloud technology employed in Electronic healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Applications in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The science of artificial intelligence, and specifically machine learning, has developed significantly in recent years. Similarly to how technology is always developing, healthcare practises are also changing. Machine learning technology is being gradually merged with medical research to improve overall outcomes and make patient care more accessible. Any technology used in healthcare that helps to decrease effort and produces outcomes quickly and efficiently should be seen as beneficial. But there are many things to take into account in this area. Healthcare appears to benefit greatly from the study of machine learning, a branch of artificial intelligence. If applied wisely, support vector algorithms and neural networks may be even more effective than the methods now employed in medicine. In order to make things simpler and produce better outcomes, this study examines numerous applications in the medical sciences.

articleTitle: ICT in Indian Higher Education Institutions: A review of Challenges and Opportunities during Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to look at the role of ICT in higher education institutions (HEIs) after Covid. Information and Communication (ICT) plays an important role in facilitating teaching and learning. ICT makes the classroom more interactive and collaborative. The education system knows the emergence of ICT in this changing digital media world. Earlier the ICT tools only used in the business and governance offices but due to pandemic the education system also used and learn the importance of the ICT tools. The way teachers and students engage and communicate with one another is one of the changes it has brought about. Given the limitations of restricted technology access and inequality in higher education in India, as well as economic considerations and technological know-how., it has to be seen how ICT can actually burgeon students and drive change in this field. This research also looks into the instruments and transformative potential of ICT in Indian higher education and in this study we used the questionnaire to investigate whether the ICT have aided the expansion of interactive learning and the teachers' role by collecting the sample of 1200 students studying in different streams of the University. Our findings contribute the valuable insights of the ICT opportunities and challenges to the students, researchers and learners.

articleTitle: Recognition of Hand Movements for Specially Abled
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The ability to recognize gestures allows a user to employ fluid gestures to deliver or transmit communication, information, facts, emotions, and sentiments. For those who do not grasp the essence of it and hence fail to comprehend it, sign language remains the most fundamental way of communicating or exchanging information to this day. These people are classified as specially-abled. In this study, a model is proposed in which the user makes a gesture in front of the camera, which is then processed through a filter and then a classifier to help the algorithm determine which gesture is made. Also given is indeed a greater knowledge of this model and the procedure. The CNN model was employed to achieve the goal, which gathers up images in real time and translates them into textual form. The text was shown on a graphical user interface that was created with Python's ‘tkinter’ GUI package. As a consequence of the research, a CNN model was created that accurately predicted proper output for images with an accuracy of 95.8% with only one layer and 98.0 percent with both layers.

articleTitle: Effort Estimation using Neural Network and Metaheuristic Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: One of the most essential factors in software development is to have an accurate forecast of workforce. In a project, the project management team must ensure accurate effort as well cost estimation in order to develop a high quality project which satisfies the customer's requirements. Inaccuracy in effort estimation of a project may lead to rejection of its development. Prognosis of effort forecasting involves prediction goals, different mechanisms for measurements, updating and refining techniques, and the processes used for execution. In the course of past few years, researches have examined various distinct problems for effort forecasting and have given newer models and techniques to minimize the errors involved. A lot of different models and approaches were surveyed to find out the trend in effort estimation and it was concluded that meta-heuristic-based models perform better as compared to other techniques proposed. So, in order to find a technique that can improve the effort accuracy, the work presented in this paper proposes a Neural Network based model which performs weight optimization using a meta-heuristic algorithm called Dragonfly algorithm. Performance of the proposed model had been evaluated using COCOMO81, Albrecht and Desharnais datasets and its performance had been compared against the effort estimation models developed using traditional machine learning algorithms viz. Random Forest and Regression Tree. The values of the performance parameters show the superior performance of the proposed meta-heuristic model as compared to the machine learning models.

articleTitle: Penetration Testing on Virtual Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Pen-testing or penetration testing is an exercise embraced to differentiate and take advantage of all the possible weaknesses in a system or network. It certifies the reasonability or deficiency of the security endeavours which have been executed. Our manuscript shows an outline of pen testing. We examine all systems, the advantages, and respective procedure of pen testing. The technique of pen testing incorporates following stages: Planning of the tests, endlessly tests investigation. The testing stage includes the following steps: Weakness investigation, data gathering and weakness exploitation. This manuscript furthermore shows the application of this procedure to direct pen testing on the model of the web applications.

articleTitle: Scientometric Analysis and Visualization of literature on Diabetic Retinopathy by using VOSViewer Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The tremendous growth in diabetic patients worldwide leads to an increase in diabetic retinopathy cases, becoming a significant health issue due to diabetes. The main aim of this study is to scrutinize the intellectual arrangement and current global trends in diabetic retinopathy and uncover its potential information. In this study, the report analysis is performed on the scientific invention and publication global trends, which are highly appropriate to identify the author's citations, co-authorship analysis, citation analysis based on documents and countries, and bibliographic coupling network by using VOSViewer software. This study focused on the “Scientometric analysis,” which is emphasized to evaluate the scientific research and development trends for diabetic retinopathy using the Scopus database. From 2000 to 2022, a total of 4491 articles were retrieved, of which 3307 documents were extracted after the bibliometric analysis filtering. This research analysis is determined by the computer engineering field and its related state-of-the-art techniques. This work provides a wide range of the existing status and trends in the application of diabetic retinopathy. It is widely used to comprehend dedicated research topics, journals, conference articles, and countries concentrating on retinal diseases.

articleTitle: IoT Based Dual Axis Solar Tracker and Irradiation Forecasting Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This work presents the development of a Dual axis solar tracker along with an IoT-based fully automated data logger and a computer program for the prediction of solar irradiance. The proposed work aims to measure, record, analyse the performance of the solar irradiance all day without the use of traditional methods and any human effort and further use the stored data for the solar irradiance forecasting for the forth-coming months by using eXtreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost) machine learning algorithm. The hardware includes a pair of Arduino Uno microcontroller, a current sensor, voltage sensor, relay and Wi-Fi module along with the two servo motors acting as actuators, Light- Dependent Resistor (LDRs) are used as light detection sensors which detects the solar rays. Further, the motor drives the solar panel towards the position of maximum incoming light. The IoT platforms “Thingspeak” and “IFTTT” are used to record and track performance of the solar irradiance respectively.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Sentiment Analysis for The Depression Detection During Covid-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter and Instagram are powerful tools to express sentiments and emotions across the globe. Researchers use sentiment analysis and its evaluation to reveal the positive, negative and neutral opinions associated with an individual or group. In this study, we have analysed the literature available on sentiment analysis based on various parameters such as publication count, year of publication, country and university wise production and keyword progression. Results reveal that sentiment analysis is a pre-owned field and researchers are contributing to this field since 2008. Collaboration among different countries and universities have also seen during this study with maximum contributions received during 2019. Further this study shows that 149 unique keywords are used by different researchers in their literature. 65 universities have contributed to the literature with the highest number of authors from India.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Quantum Machine Learning Technique to Determine Insurance Claim Fraud
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is an upcoming and active research field that uses quantum computing concepts for machine learning. This paper presents QML techniques for detecting fraud in housing insurance claims. Insurance fraud detection is challenging as the patterns may be complex. Therefore, various techniques and methods are employed to identify suspicious claims and prevent business losses due to these fraudulent claims. This paper explores Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM) techniques and feature engineering, feature selection, and parameter tweaking to identify fraudulent housing insurance claims. In addition, it compares Quantum SVM with classical SVM. Finally, this paper focuses on detecting property insurance claims fraud by using machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: A Price Discount Scheme for Non-Instantaneous Inventory System with Shortage
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Optimal pricing and replacement policies are the two significant factors in a deteriorating inventory model. These papers address an EOQ model for a non-instantaneous inventory system in a three-stage inventory level. Price-sensitive market demand has been assumed to predict the uncertain market. A price discount policy has been analyzed during the periods of deterioration. In addition, a shortage in the retailer's inventory has been considered with a partial backlogging rate. The objective of this research is to find the optimal product pricing, inventory cycle length, and inventory cycle length so that the optimal profit will be maximized. Finally, a numerical illustration is presented to validate the proposed model, and sensitivity analyses are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the key parameters.

articleTitle: Forensic Analysis of WhatsApp chat data
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Due to the widespread use of mobile phones and wireless applications, there is unquestionably a surge in cybercrimes. As a result, there is an urgent need for mobile forensics. The investigators should decide one of the three gathering types—manual, logical, or physical—to use before starting an investigation. The existing mobile acquisition technologies exploit these in various ways to create images of all mobile content, files of particular data categories, or data from a particular application. The tool may capture more data than necessary, forcing researchers to individually filter data may, or it may obtain all of the data, but this does not help with the examination of instances involving a particular mobile application. Data from the application without adequate analysis both in instances need a lot of work and time. This study compares and analyses forensics presently accessible and gives a demonstrated view of available tools that can perform data extraction and forensic investigations on WhatsApp. This study also discusses the mechanism behind the messenger technology, protocols behind the technology, and different ways to extract the data from the mobile phone to perform forensic analysis. Additionally, this study focuses on the weak points of the tools technology and suggests better methods to improve the vast field of WhatsApp forensics.

articleTitle: Case Study on Detection and Prevention Methods in Zero Day Attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the cyber world, zero day means it is a defect that is previously unknown to vendors or developers but already known by hackers and is being exploited by them. Because these defects are unknown to developers there is high risk and impact when the attack happens. With all these problems, there are only a few surveys that researchers could look into. Case Studies help researchers to understand current developments in detection and prevention techniques for zero day attacks. With the understanding of current developments, the researchers could be able to create new solutions. This paper briefly covers zero day attacks, their impact, classification, and available solutions. This paper covers a useful reference by which the researchers could see current technologies available for the detection and prevention of zero day attacks.

articleTitle: Generalization of Fourier Transformation of Scaling Function using Riesz basis on L2 (K)
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Various applications of multi resolution analysis has been proved in analysis of coding, time frequency etc. One of its important role has been pointed out in the area of applied mathematics which is connected to the wavelets.In this work an analysis of scaling function together with its observation in the closed subspaces of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{L}^{2}(\mathbf{K})$</tex> has been done. Futhermore, it consists of the observation for the riesz basis in the multi resolution analysis with its form in terms of scaling function. It is also proved that the bounds can be found for the scaling function with the use of the transformation of function. The intersection property is proved as single element, with use of translates of riesz basis. It is concluded that the riesz basis can play an important role in the formation of bounds for the scaling function and it is used for the Fourier transformation for the same with respect to the intersection property as single element.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Yoga Pose Recognition System using Hyperparameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: People have been forgetful of health concerns due to hectic schedules and busy lifestyles. As much as they wish to give priority to healthcare, they aren't able to because it's a choice. The fitness community has been booming in the last few years, with people becoming conscious about their general health. A majority of this community had resorted to Yoga, allowing them to access gateways to earn peace and spirituality. The issue with this would be the accuracy of the Asana being performed. Therefore, an automated deep learning-based yoga pose recognition system is proposed in the present research to accurately recognize the yoga pose performed by the user. The proposed system is divided into three modules: pose detection using MediaPipe, pose recognition using the proposed deep learning model, and alert generation. The intended model is optimized by using the concept of hyperparameter tuning. All the experiments are conducted on a self-created dataset of 5 poses and achieved a 99.6% recognition rate providing competent accuracy with other existing state-of-the-art techniques.

articleTitle: The Significance of Satisfaction-index and a Methodology to Evaluate a Customer Satisfaction Index Based on a Study Done for UPES
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The work presented in this paper is the outcome of the study that was based on the online surveys conducted at UPES for the improvement of IT related services. First, the qualitative approach has opted in which brainstorming sessions are done and questions for the survey are collected. The second approach is applied based on quantitative research in which a questionnaire is prepared and circulated to end-user of IT services at “The University of Petroleum and Energy Studies”, UPES, Dehradun. The survey is circulated to the staff and faculties of UPES for feedback. The biannual survey is done in the first month of the year 2021 and then repeated after improving the IT services, second survey was conducted in July 2021. A methodology is proposed and adopted to validate the study. The statistical techniques are applied and based on this satisfaction index SI is computed for both the surveys. The SI comparison of both surveys shows that the SI value has been improved with a 0.13 index in the second survey. This concludes that these types of survey-based studies are very important for organizations that have deployed IT-based services in their organizations. This paper also suggests that the SI value is based on the end-user and it always hinders the performance of the users in their day-to-day tasks. So, performance evaluation of end-user satisfaction plays an integral role in the development of any organization.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of Inverse Gaussian Junctionless GAA based Biosensor with temperature Variation
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, the analysis of junctionless-based Gate All Around (GAA) field effect transistor for detecting the neutral biomolecules is reported by considering an inverse Gaussian doping profile. A detailed study on the proposed biosensor's performance parameters such as ON current, OFF current, ON/OFF current ratio, surface-center potential, electric field, threshold voltage, and transconductance have been explored. The device has also been investigated for temperature analysis. The lower OFF current of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{10^{-17}\mathrm{A}}$</tex> along with ON Current of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{10^{-6}}$</tex>. A resulting ON/OFF current switching ratio of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{10^{11}}$</tex> is obtained for K=10 and the order of 3 improved for detection of APTES (cancer biomarkers). The temperature effect has shown that the sensitivity is higher for high k biomolecules immobilized in the cavity region. It is observed that the threshold voltage sensitivity is 51% enhanced. The Visual TCAD (licensed version 1.9.2-3) tool is used for the parameter analysis.

articleTitle: Behavior Monitoring of Lizards Based on Inertial Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In order to protect reptile pets, this paper takes the common breeding species of lizard―Pogona vitticeps as an example to study their behavior and posture characteristics, so as to specify protection measures or provide references for breeders. Existing literature mainly carry out research through video recognition. In this paper, inertial sensors, which are applicable to a wider range of activities, can identify night conditions, and have more abundant motion feature indicators are used. This paper presents an experimental scenario suitable for Pogona vitticeps, and designs an inertial sensor. According to the behavior of Pogona vitticeps, the behavior characteristic indexes are proposed, and the automatic classification of inertial sensor data is realized by support vector machine algorithm. Finally, experimental data under different temperature and lighting conditions are classified and counted, and the influence of temperature and light is given.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Controller Design with Different Membership Functions for PV Solar Cell System with Microgrid and Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The energy demand is increasing continuously at a faster rate in the modern world. There is a need to shift towards clean energy options to save the environment. Renewable sources are one of the best choices to achieve energy demand without polluting the surroundings. This work involves the integration of fuel cells, PV Array, and battery with the grid. Further, Fuzzy controllers are used to obtaining optimum output voltage. The comparison is done for voltage/current outputs involving various types of fuzzy membership functions such as triangular, trapezoidal gaussian, and modified trapezoidal. The simulation results indicate that triangular, trapezoidal, and Gaussian membership functions yield similar results. The modified trapezoidal membership function with increased width results in far superior results. By the application of the modified trapezoidal membership functions, output voltage and current waveforms have turned uniform, and distortion is also removed to a large extent.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Universal Generating Function in Reliability Assessment of Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Any practical engineering system is considered to be of superior quality if it has high reliability or the likelihood of proper operation over a specific time period. However, in most cases, it is a strenuous task to obtain precise data because of various shortcomings. Thus, fuzzy reliability forms an appropriate tool in such cases. Here, the fuzzy reliability and availability assessment are conducted on a thermal power plant model. The thermal power system is responsible for more than half of the world's power consumption demand and thus, they need to be of high quality and reliability. The system considered is a fuzzy multi-state system and all the variables involved are fuzzy variables represented by triangular fuzzy numbers. The fuzzy universal generating function (FUGF) technique is applied for the evaluation of fuzzy reliability and availability of the system.

articleTitle: Pancreatic Carcinoma Detection with Publicly available Radiological Images: A Systematic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Pancreatic carcinoma is the fifth deadliest melanoma existing worldwide. It shares the maximum percentage of total mortalities caused by cancer every year. The main cause of the high mortality and minimal survival rate is the delayed detection of abnormal cell growth in pancreatic regions of patients diagnosed with this ailment. In recent years, researchers have been putting effort into the early detection of pancreatic carcinoma in radiological imaging scans of the whole abdomen. In this paper, the authors have systematically reviewed the data reported and various works done on publicly available imaging datasets of pancreatic cancer. The analyzed datasets are Pancreas- Computed Tomography, Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma from The Cancer Imaging Archive, and Pancreas Tumor from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon online repository. The review is supported by reporting incidences depending on age group, clinical history, physical conditions, pathological findings, tumor nature, region, stage, and tumor size of examined patients. The outcomes of categorized subjects will aid academicians, research scholars, and industrialists to understand the propagation of pancreatic cancer for early detection in computer-aided systems.

articleTitle: Role of Cloud Computing in Facilitating Educational Excellence, A Case Study of Higher Education Institution in Oman
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Education systems have evolved over the years with learners as receptacles of knowledge to learners as contributors in the learning process efficiently collaborating, communicating, and connecting. Inclusion of social networking into learning and the inception of technology-aided teaching and learning and student-centered approaches, most certainly education systems have evolved over the years directed by the modernization and inclusion of technology in education. Education 4.0 is desired where co-creation and innovation will be the center of focus. This research work presents a case study of a higher education institution that has embedded and adopted cloud computing technology to facilitate Education 4.0 with cloud-based learning. The research study can be a significant means or a use case for higher education establishments to replicate for transformation to Education 4.0 and attainment of Educational excellence in their institutions.

articleTitle: CNN Model for Segmenting Whole Slide Images of the Kidney
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In recent years, the classification and detection of glomeruli images has now become the most important study field in renal disease therapy. With the advancement of computer-aided systems, a greater emphasis has been placed on deep learning for glomerular detection. In this paper, a segmentation-based model using deep learning has been developed to detect glomeruli in images of human renal tissues. The performance of the proposed deep learning model has been evaluated in terms of different performance metrics to validate the results and ensure the system's efficiency. With the proposed model, the achieved accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-Score comes out to be 94.7%, 95.4%, 93.1%, and 94.2%, respectively, which demonstrate that the proposed model does a better job than the current state of methods.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Cloud Computing Security Threats and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The demand for Cloud Computing (CC) is increasing at a higher growth rate because of the emerging technologies like machine learning, artificial intelligence, big data analytics, IoT, mobile supercomputing, serverless computing, and the industrial need for reducing operational costs. Cloud computing features such as customized offerings, pay-as-you-go or pay-per-use model, availability, seamless scalability, and flexibility have accelerated the demand for cloud services. Despite these many benefits, security is the top challenge in the adoption of cloud services. However, the recent research studies lack the gap between analyzing potential security threats and an exhaustive list of countermeasures proposed for mitigating the threats. The main objective of this paper is to provide a comprehensive view of cloud security threats and to identify potential (more vulnerable) threats. Further, the taxonomy of proposed solutions is provided for data security and privacy on the basis of analysis of research papers in the last decade.

articleTitle: Accuracy and Performance Enhancement of Machine Learning System for Ids
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: To keep sensitive data safe, intrusion detection systems must be in place. Fast and precise attack detection is possible because of the basic method. Network-based solutions may be used to monitor traffic volume, external IP addresses, ports, and protocols. The intrusion detection system was built using a wide range of components. A significant number of security issues are triggered by sensors. An intrusion has been detected, and the system has sent an alert. Another portion is the console. When engaged, an “aarm” or “burglar alarm” serves as an ID. With a solid lock system, burglars would be unable to enter your home. Intruders will be alerted if the lock system is tampered with, and an alarm will sound. Predictive operations may be feasible in an industrial setting, according to observations. It is possible to teach automated systems how to spot abnormal behavior by collecting and evaluating data from various sensors linked to them. To train and forecast intrusion detection, there has been earlier research, however, these studies took a lengthy time. There was also a lack of accuracy. To deal with intrusions as quickly and effectively as possible, our research aims to create an intelligent system that can quickly and reliably recognize and classify them. To train and assess IDS data sets, a neural network approach was used.

articleTitle: On Reducing Power during Test Process of FPGAs
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) market is forecasted to reach capitalization of 25.85 billion USD by 2030 as it grows currently at a compound annual growth rate of 11.2%. FPGAs market however, destined to be highly competitive given a variety of intrinsic factors such as economics of scale, the kinds of items and products available and the downright favorable conditions for the bigger firms that have much lower fixed costs. In a wide range of industries, which comprises automotive, top end level computing, defense, consumer electronics and communications is bound to be interesting. The sheer demand for FPGAs use in Internet of Things (IoT) devices, even branches of Artificial Intelligence (AI) that deal with giving computers the ability to understand text and spoken words very much the same way as humans do, based infotainment, and wide range of systems combining innovative technologies; both in terms of hardware (IoT and software). The R&D sector of FPGA market is very well funded and therefore innovation in the FPGA sector has been implemented at breath taking speeds. Power consumption is the greatest issue facing FPGAs especially during testing process, and this is the main topic research community in field of FPGAs concentrates on. FPGAs unlock advantages for Deep Learning (DL) and AI based solutions, which comprises higher performance with low latency and high throughput. Although, FPGAs being highly attributed are associated with the weakness of their power consumption and that issue cannot be ignored. Hence, power reduction has been an important research area, considered by the research community working in the field of FPGAs. The issue of power consumption is more of concern during the testing process of FPGAs. This talk is designed to look into the different mechanisms of reducing the power consumption during the test process of FPGAs.

articleTitle: Offload 802.11 scanning to low power device
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this generation, Wi-Fi throughput is increasing day by day, with the speed of Wi-Fi data also increasing exponentially. From full HD, 2K to 4K, and 8K video watching standards are improving very fast for users. Users want to roam without any impact on user browsing. The challenge is to backward scan without interrupting the existing connection during roaming. This paper focuses on a low power external device specially designed for scanning purposes. An external Wi-Fi radio is introduced to make scanning faster and improve power saving during the connection process.

articleTitle: Image Forgery Detection Using Structural Similarity and Morphological Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Recent advancements in digital imaging technology and computer vision have brought forth a multitude of new possibilities in every field ranging from manufacturing to healthcare and graphic designing to virtual reality. With the many benefits that these advancements have brought when this technology falls into unscrupulous and malicious hands its effects can be adverse. Nowadays, it is possible for anyone to easily manipulate images to an extent that makes it seamless to the human eye, making it impossible to distinguish between an original and a counterfeit image. An immensely popular example of this technology is deepfake technology, which has the potential to create entirely false narratives of people as the results of deepfake media have started to look stunningly believable. To be able to distinguish what is real and what is not, we need to be able to measure the structural similarity between both real and fake images. For this purpose, we need a metric that can effectively distinguish different structures in an image. Two such widely used metrics are Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM). These metrics can also be used in assessing the quality of an image by comparing it with a lossy and compressed version of itself to understand the degradation in quality. This research applies morphological tools over MSE and SSIM and provides a series of experiments. The intent is to compare both metrics and conclude which of the two provides us with a more accurate description of the structural differences between two images. Our result shows that using a combination of morphological tools i.e., Erosion and Dilation (collectively called Opening), with SSIM provides better results to find the differences or similarities among images.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Methods of Detecting Human Using Computer Vision by Incorporating Machine-Learning Techniques in Open Environment at Diverse Viewpoints
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Over the period detecting human has become the most prominent area of research. To identify human different researchers have adopted various methods to create a framework that would be feasible for autonomous systems. Such systems if deployed in open environment has to face enormous challenges where human intervention is negligible. This paper depicts various arenas where computer vision with machine learning is used. With usage this paper portrays the deep aspect of the approaches used to identify human under two major categories of classifying distant objects and other classifying at different viewpoints. Because of these categorizations there are enormous challenges faced by researchers and how their endeavors still do not end in order to achieve the accuracy.

articleTitle: GUI Calculator Testing for Finite State Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, we have proposed the testing of the Graphical User Interface (GUI) applications using the idea of finite state machines. Results have been compares with the model generated using Simulink's script, represents the machine that tested the actual GUI. This environment can help in writing efficient test cases to test the actual graphical interfaces of the application under the test. For the testing of our system, a small GUI for the calculator has been developed, and then the finite state diagram for the same design has been used as a machine for the simulation. The results from the Simulink model are compared with the actual application. The defects are also identified and have been presented.

articleTitle: Effect of Wilkinson Power Divider on Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, a linear four element antenna array has been designed and analysed with beam steering capabilities. The beam steering operation is achieved using varactor diodes by changing the phase difference generated at each array element. The antenna utilises eight such diodes and three Wilkinson power dividers for in phase current distribution to each of the radiating element. The proposed array antenna has a compact size of 30 mm x 20 mm and a thickness of 0.5 mm. It is able to steer the radiating beam from -11 degree to +11 degree depending on the capacitance generated by the varactors, at a frequency of 32 GHz, applicable in modern 5G communication networks.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis to Detect the Research Status in Flying Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: FANETs field has become increasingly popular due to its wide range of applications, but its usage is still limited due to low efficiency and packet delivery problem. Hence, many researchers have started developing solutions to this problem. This paper presents a comprehensive bibliometric analysis based on statistics, topic, and collaborative research. Statistical analysis was used to identify the productivity and impact of authors, organizations, and countries based on the number of published papers and citation count. For topic analysis, the top 10 keywords were identified using statistics. We also created the co-occurrence network for keywords to identify the research landscape and hotspot within this field. Similarly, for collaborative analysis, we used the VOSviewer tool. We created co-authorship networks to identify the collaboration between the authors, organizations, and countries. From the result, we can observe an insight into the characteristics of publications and the key contributors in the past two decades. The paper aims to help researchers understand the development status and trends in this field.

articleTitle: Design and Implimentation of Cathode Ray Oscilloscope using microcontroller and GLCD
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: AVR's CRO is a realistic LCD capable of displaying a wide range of waves such as square, triangular, and other shapes. This might be used as a testing tool for a table CRO (device for testing). In this paper a fully assembled and tested CRO using AVR-06 microcontroller is tested and developed as well as model of the business. It is usually the hand-crafted model using the general purpose PCB that takes Electronics and Electrical components according to the model's requirements. AVR microcontroller is a highly developed version of a minicomputer with a CPU, memory, and programmable input/output peripheral devices packed into a small chip. This ATmega32 is called low-power CMOS of 8-bit microcontroller with AVR improved RISC functionality. AVR When the frequency is 1MHz, it will perform 1 million instructions / second.

articleTitle: Embedded Vehicle Alarm and Break Light System
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The present work provides a brake light(s) system for a vehicle. A large number of rear-end collisions take place each year because suddenly applied brakes by the leading vehicle doesn't even give an instant to follower vehicle to apply a brake and the same impact keeps on. The proposed system includes a set of sensors configured on the front portion of a vehicle to sense one or more attributes associated with another vehicle that is positioned in front of this vehicle. The vehicle consists of a control unit operatively coupled with the set of sensors to extract one or more parameter values. The extracted one or more parameter values are compared with a dataset comprising a set of predefined threshold values. Based on the comparison, when the extracted one or more parameter values is more than the predefined threshold values, the control unit generates a break light alert signal indicative of the second vehicle being within a predefined range of the first vehicle.

articleTitle: Prediction of Composition parameters of Cortical bone using Artificial Neutral Network
publicationTitle: 2022 10th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The goal of this article is to look at the viability of employing artificial neural network programming to forecast cortical bone composition characteristics.
